correctness.summary: The known cut lower bound gives ab|V(H)|^2-(a+b+min{a,b})|E(H)|. A proper edge-colouring of H supplies matchings that can be packed as K4s across paired copies and as triangles for excess copies, with the chromatic-index hypothesis preventing crossing-edge collisions. The constructed partition meets the lower bound exactly.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The directly related 2026 result treats only balanced joins of complete clusters with even clique size. A 2021 one-sided join identity and the classical cut bound were also checked. Exact and synonymous searches found no two-sided repeated-graph formula or the asymmetric parity-free complete-cluster corollary.

value.summary: The theorem identifies chromatic index as a general mechanism forcing equality in a classical clique-partition cut bound, extends a recent extremal construction from complete clusters to arbitrary repeated graphs, and yields exact partition, covering, and spread formulas for an asymmetric three-parameter complete-cluster family.

limitations: The condition min{a,b} >= chi'(H) is sufficient and is not claimed necessary.
For arbitrary H only the clique partition number is determined; the clique covering number is additionally determined for H complete.
The theorem does not improve the known global asymptotic order of the maximum spread deficit.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; unindexed equivalent formulations remain possible.
Independent audit has not been performed.
